headline: Looted police pistol and ammunition found in Narayanganj mosque
summary: A 9mm pistol, two magazines, and 20 rounds of bullets recovered from Araihazar Bazar Mosque after being looted during the August uprising.
details: A 9mm pistol, two magazines, and 20 rounds of ammunition were recovered from Araihazar Bazar Mosque in Narayanganj this afternoon.
The weapons were found on a shelf on the first floor of the mosque, spotted by the mosque's imam, Maulana Md Nasir Uddin.
Police confirmed that the items had been looted from the Araihazar Police Station during the mass uprising on August 5, 2024.
Authorities suspect the weapons were left at the mosque during Juma prayers on Friday, as the location saw a high volume of devotees.
The imam stated that a local youth had informed him about the pistol and bullets after Maghrib prayers on Friday.
According to the imam, other looted items, including weapons and handcuffs, had previously been left at the mosque and handed over to the army and police.
Police are currently investigating to identify who left the looted firearms and ammunition at the mosque.
caption:
A looted police pistol and 20 rounds of ammunition were found sitting on a mosque shelf in Narayanganj.

A 9mm pistol, two magazines, and 20 rounds of ammunition were recovered from Araihazar Bazar Mosque in Narayanganj this afternoon.

The weapons were found on a shelf on the first floor of the mosque, spotted by the mosque's imam, Maulana Md Nasir Uddin.

Police confirmed that the items had been looted from the Araihazar Police Station during the mass uprising on August 5, 2024.

Authorities suspect the weapons were left at the mosque during Juma prayers on Friday, as the location saw a high volume of devotees.

The imam stated that a local youth had informed him about the pistol and bullets after Maghrib prayers on Friday.

According to the imam, other looted items, including weapons and handcuffs, had previously been left at the mosque and handed over to the army and police.

Police are currently investigating to identify who left the looted firearms and ammunition at the mosque.

Source: Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: 3 bodies recovered after [[4 swept away in Shitalakshya River]] in Narsingdi
headline: 3 bodies recovered after 4 swept away in Shitalakshya River in Narsingdi
summary: Three people, including a 16-year-old girl, have been found dead after being swept away by strong currents while bathing in the river.
details: Bodies of three people were recovered from the Shitalakshya River in Shibpur upazila of Narsingdi, a day after four people went missing while bathing.
The deceased have been identified as Md Obaidullah (38), Shanta (16), and Sourav (20).
The victims had gone to the river to bathe around 4:30 pm yesterday after visiting a relative's home in Lakhpur village.
According to police and locals, Obaidullah, Shanta, and Shanto did not know how to swim and were swept away by the strong current.
Sourav drowned while attempting to rescue the others from the river.
A diving team from Bhairab resumed the search in the morning, covering a 6–10km stretch of the river.
Shanta's body was eventually spotted around 10km away at Dighua in Kaliganj upazila.
Rescue operations are still ongoing to locate the remaining missing person, 24-year-old Shanto.
caption:
3 bodies recovered, 1 still missing. A bathing trip in Narsingdi turned fatal as strong currents swept away four people.

Bodies of three people were recovered from the Shitalakshya River in Shibpur upazila of Narsingdi, a day after four people went missing while bathing.

The deceased have been identified as Md Obaidullah (38), Shanta (16), and Sourav (20).

The victims had gone to the river to bathe around 4:30 pm yesterday after visiting a relative's home in Lakhpur village.

According to police and locals, Obaidullah, Shanta, and Shanto did not know how to swim and were swept away by the strong current.

Sourav drowned while attempting to rescue the others from the river.

A diving team from Bhairab resumed the search in the morning, covering a 6–10km stretch of the river.

Shanta's body was eventually spotted around 10km away at Dighua in Kaliganj upazila.

Rescue operations are still ongoing to locate the remaining missing person, 24-year-old Shanto.
